subject: microbiology
title: Viridans Streptococci, Enterococcus and Endocarditis Microbiology

steps.tx: **Viridans streptococci** are alpha or non haemolytic oral commensals named by groups (mitis, mutans, salivarius, anginosus, bovis gallolyticus), entering blood at dental work and mucositis, causing subacute native valve endocarditis classically, dental caries (mutans), and abscesses (anginosus group). Gallolyticus bacteraemia signals colonic neoplasia investigation.
steps.say: Mouth streptococci in blood ask about valves, teeth and, for gallolyticus, the colon.

left.title: Viridans groups
points: Mitis group: endocarditis and neutropenic sepsis
Gallolyticus (bovis): endocarditis plus colon cancer link

steps.tx: **Viridans streptococci** are alpha or non haemolytic oral commensals grouped as mitis, mutans, salivarius, anginosus, and bovis gallolyticus. They enter blood during dental work and mucositis and classically cause subacute native valve endocarditis. Mutans group organisms drive dental caries, and the anginosus group drives abscesses. Streptococcus gallolyticus bacteraemia is a signal to look for colonic neoplasia.
steps.say: Oral viridans streptococci, grouped as mitis, mutans, salivarius, anginosus, and gallolyticus, seed blood at dental work. They cause subacute native valve endocarditis, caries from mutans, and abscesses from anginosus. Gallolyticus in blood prompts a search for colon cancer.

vis.alt: A close view of teeth shows plaque and a carious cavity on an occlusal surface.
vis.caption: Dental plaque coats enamel beside an established carious lesion, the oral niche of viridans streptococci. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Enterococcus** (faecalis and faecium) is salt tolerant (6.5 percent NaCl), bile aesculin positive, PYR positive, growing at extremes (10 to 45 degrees, pH 9.6), intrinsic low level aminoglycoside and cephalosporin resistance built in, causing urinary, biliary, endocarditis and device infections, faecium increasingly vancomycin resistant (VRE module).
steps.say: Salt, bile, PYR and intrinsic cephalosporin immunity: enterococcus identified and underestimated.

right.title: Two species fork
points: Faecium: ampicillin resistant usually, VRE leaning

steps.tx: **Infective endocarditis microbiology** obeys blood culture discipline: three sets from separate sites before antibiotics in subacute presentations, continuous bacteraemia making timing flexible, viridans, gallolyticus, enterococcus, aureus and HACEK as native valve cast, prosthetic adding CoNS and fungi, culture negative pathways (serology and valve PCR) beyond.
steps.say: Three sets, separate sites, before antibiotics: endocarditis culture law.

steps.tx: **Infective endocarditis microbiology** depends on blood culture discipline before any antibiotic. In subacute illness, three sets are drawn from separate sites. Continuous bacteraemia makes the clock of collection less rigid than in ordinary sepsis. Native valve casts include viridans streptococci, Streptococcus gallolyticus, enterococci, Staphylococcus aureus, and the HACEK group. Prosthetic valves add coagulase negative staphylococci and fungi. Culture negative pathways then use serology and valve PCR.
steps.say: Draw three blood culture sets from separate sites before antibiotics when endocarditis is subacute, because bacteraemia is continuous. Native valves grow viridans, gallolyticus, enterococci, aureus, or HACEK organisms. Prostheses add coagulase negative staphylococci and fungi. Serology and valve PCR cover culture negative cases.

vis.alt: An echocardiogram frame shows a mobile vegetation attached to a mitral valve leaflet.
vis.caption: A mitral leaflet carries a mobile echo dense vegetation consistent with infective endocarditis. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Endocarditis synergy testing** matters for enterococcus: high level aminoglycoside resistance screens (gentamicin and streptomycin) predict whether cell wall plus aminoglycoside synergy can kill, ampicillin plus ceftriaxone the modern faecalis alternative avoiding aminoglycoside kidneys. The bench report writes the regimen. The result also determines whether six weeks of therapy can avoid aminoglycoside monitoring, blood level assays and the renal injuries that accompany prolonged synergy courses.
steps.say: High level gentamicin resistance closes the synergy door; ampicillin ceftriaxone opens another.

left.title: Synergy logic
points: Enterococci intrinsically low level aminoglycoside resistant
Cell wall agent admits aminoglycoside for synergy
HLAR: synergy lost, do not waste toxicity
Screens at high concentration discs or MIC

right.title: Regimen echoes
points: Duration weeks by valve and organism

steps.tx: **Dental source control** in viridans disease (caries, periapical abscess, mucositis in neutropenia where viridans can shock) and prophylaxis restriction to highest risk cardiac lesions for invasive dental procedures, stewardship having narrowed older generous prophylaxis, complete the mouth heart axis. Guidelines differ internationally on this point, so local rheumatic and endocarditis epidemiology should be quoted when examination answers defend a prophylaxis policy.
steps.say: Prophylaxis narrowed to the highest risk hearts; treat teeth, spare antibiotics.

left.title: Prophylaxis indications
points: Single dose amoxicillin tradition where indicated

right.title: Source realities
points: Daily chewing bacteraemia exceeds procedure spikes

steps.tx: **Anginosus group** (intermedius, constellatus, anginosus) deserves separate respect: abscess specialists of brain, liver, pleura and abdomen, often polymicrobial with anaerobes, milleri heritage name, drainage dominating cure. Alpha streptococcus from an abscess is not a bystander label. Caramel odour on the plate is a folkloric clue some benches still record, though nobody should report an identification from smell alone in a modern laboratory.
steps.say: Anginosus in pus means find the abscess cavity and drain it.

left.title: Anginosus behaviour
points: Small colonies, variable haemolysis, caramel odour tradition

steps.tx: **Enterococcus urinary and biliary reality** tempers alarm: catheter urine enterococcus often colonisation (treat symptoms, pregnancy, procedures), bacteraemia demands source and endocarditis thought (especially faecalis persistent), and faecium in units with VRE demands infection control from the genetics module. Echocardiography thresholds are lower for faecalis than for many organisms because enterococcal endocarditis can smoulder with modest fever and a new murmur alone.
steps.say: Enterococcus in catheter urine is often a passenger; in persistent blood it is a plaintiff.

left.title: Colonisation leaning
points: Treat by symptoms and host plans

steps.tx: **Streptococcus like others** (Abiotrophia nutritionally variant, Granulicatella, Gemella, Aerococcus) hide in culture negative endocarditis traditions (pyridoxal dependent satelliting colonies), MALDI and molecular methods naming them faster. Their lesson: slow alpha streptococci from valves deserve extended incubation and referral. Enriched carbon dioxide incubation and pyridoxal supplemented media rescue some of these colonies before sequencing is considered necessary.
steps.say: Satelliting colonies around staph streaks: nutritionally variant streptococci confessing needs.

left.title: Fastidious kin
points: Gemella and Aerococcus urinary and blood niches
